figurative_meaning_en: Ruthless relative; a close person harboring intense enmity
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার নিজের ভাইপোর প্রতি কংস মামার মতো নির্মম।
আমার সেই চাচাতো ভাই তো পুরো কংস মামা স্বরূপ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is ruthless towards his own nephew like Kansa mama.
My cousin is a real Kansa mama in behavior.
history: Refers to Kansa, the tyrannical maternal uncle of Lord Krishna in Hindu mythology, who imprisoned his sister Devaki and Vasudeva out of fear of a prophecy and attempted to kill the infant Krishna.
note: Derived from the Bhagavata Purana and other Hindu texts, commonly used in Bengali to denote familial betrayal.
